title: Assessments
lead: Browse assessment categories. Open an assessment to complete it. Content is available to admin accounts, or with an access code.

assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Wellness Therapist understands the purpose, technique, timing, benefits, client expectation management, consent, hygiene, boundaries, safety and professional mindset required for Lunez Massage.

categories.title: Problem-Solving Mindset
categories.description: Knowledge and application assessments for the Problem-Solving Mindset standard.

assessments.title: Problem-Solving Mindset Applied Assessment
assessments.summary: 25 applied questions. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Wellness Therapist understands and can apply a problem-solving mindset: staying calm, checking facts, acting within authority, communicating, escalating when needed, protecting the client experience, and learning from problems.
